registration.scope: Same AWS A100 GPU 6 and RTX 4090 GPU 0, stock-profile BF16 checkpoint, diagnostic-only binary, private SSH path per replica, original 25% model-mediated versus 75% app-executed tool path.
registration.acceptance: Both selected repeats must pass 152/160 workflow SLO minimum with at most 8 rejects and no unexpected correctness or transport errors. The same 20-second 2/s and 4/s preludes are used before each 8/s cell with fresh replicas. 8/s input schedule and named-tool mode stay unchanged.
registration.intervention: Weighted outstanding-turn cost, AWS:RTX capacity weights 3:2, one unit per named tool HTTP request and four per final. Followup changes only HTTP workers (8 to 16), active slots (8 to 12) and engine waiting limit (2 to 4).
registration.instrumentation: HTTP queue timing uses socket enqueue to worker acquisition. HTTP framing/normalization and engine admission use monotonic timestamps on the serving host. Server/client decomposition compares durations across clocks. All measured scenarios use the same diagnostic binary. The historic traces contain only the client clock.
